repository.commit_message: fix(editor): fail closed on malformed saved node records
repository.push: normal fast-forward; no force push, reset, or branch switch

defect_and_fix.reproduction: A saved Page Model can contain a null or primitive value in page.nodes. The accessibility preflight dereferenced node.metadata and assertValidEditorDocument inspected the malformed node before hierarchy validation, leaking a TypeError instead of the controlled invalid-document state.
fix: Accessibility validation skips malformed node values so structural validation remains the single diagnostic path.
Hierarchy validation reports non-object, null, and array node records as invalid node record and does not dereference parentId on them.
assertValidEditorDocument skips semantic checks for malformed records and lets validateEditorDocument reject them through its normal error path.
Added unit coverage for a null root record, null orphan record, and false primitive orphan; validation neither repairs nor serializes altered data.
Extended the real Chromium Editor boot regression with persisted null/false nodes and asserts controlled feedback, no page errors, zero writes, and unchanged snapshot.
Updated the validation-module browser cache key for commands and state.
defect_and_fix.save_publish: Separate and unchanged; corrupt data is not automatically rewritten and loading it invokes neither Save nor Publish.

targeted_chromium.coverage: Malformed persisted child IDs, duplicate references, null and false node records; controlled Editor boot error, no unhandled page errors, no Save/Publish writes, unchanged Page Model snapshot.
